name: The Unknown
hook_pattern: I spent [TIME_PERIOD] building the "perfect" protein powder.
body_pattern:
Organic. Third-party tested. Beautiful packaging.

Then I put it on Amazon.

Week 1: 3 sales.
Week 2: 7 sales.
Week 3: I panicked.

So I did something different.

I messaged 200 fitness micro-influencers on Instagram.

Not the big ones. The ones with 2K-10K followers.

I offered free product. No strings attached.

47 said yes.
23 actually posted about it.
8 became genuine fans.

Month 4: 800 units sold.
Month 6: [BIG_NUMBER] units sold.
Month 12: I quit my day job.

The product didn't change. The distribution did.

Stop perfecting your product.
Start perfecting your distribution.

What channel drives most of your sales?

example_post:
I spent 6 months building the "perfect" protein powder.

Organic. Third-party tested. Beautiful packaging.

Then I put it on Amazon.

Week 1: 3 sales.
Week 2: 7 sales.
Week 3: I panicked.

So I did something different.

I messaged 200 fitness micro-influencers on Instagram.

Not the big ones. The ones with 2K-10K followers.

I offered free product. No strings attached.

47 said yes.
23 actually posted about it.
8 became genuine fans.

Month 4: 800 units sold.
Month 6: 2,400 units sold.
Month 12: I quit my day job.

The product didn't change. The distribution did.

Stop perfecting your product.
Start perfecting your distribution.

What channel drives most of your sales?

HOOK: Write a compelling opening line.
BODY: Tell a narrative with a clear arc: situation → conflict → resolution. Use short paragraphs.
CTA: End with a question that invites your audience to share their own experience.
FORMAT: Use line breaks between short sentences for readability. Target ~111 words.
